name: box-office-war
description: A realistic movie-business simulation game that runs in any browser — phone, tablet, or PC. No installs, no dependencies, no server: pure HTML/CSS/JS, works offline (just open index.html).

scripts.apk: node apk/build-www.js && cd apk && npx --no-install cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/ui-test.mjs && node test/balance.js && node test/scenario-playthrough.mjs && node test/sandbox-audit.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:lot && node test/arcs.js
scripts.test:lot: node test/lot-engine.cjs && node test/lot-complete.cjs && node test/lot-living.cjs && node test/lot-people.cjs && node test/lot-seating.cjs
scripts.test:management: node test/command-deck.mjs && node test/management-audit.mjs && node test/header-settings-guide.mjs && node test/develop-deck.mjs && node test/boxoffice-deck.mjs && node test/boxoffice-charts.mjs && node test/rebrand-streamer.mjs && node test/cost-sheet.mjs
scripts.test:boxoffice: node test/boxoffice-deck.mjs && node test/rebrand-streamer.mjs && node test/cost-sheet.mjs
